subject: OrbitGrove pilot: combined trial extension + credits & first-year discount approval
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@orbitgrove.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@orbitgrove.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OrbitGrove pilot kickoff — credit + extension proposal

Hi Ethan / Priya,

Great meeting yesterday — thanks for walking through the integration plan. As discussed, OrbitGrove is ramping the multi-model search pilot and wants to validate latency and embedding quality at scale before committing. To remove friction we can offer a combined package: a 30-day trial extension, 50k free-token credit for inference, and a first-year usage discount tied to a 12-month minimum commit.

Before I put this package in front of finance and marketing for a binding offer, can you confirm:
- Target monthly token run-rate during pilot (rough ballpark)
- Whether you need the contract/PO before the trial extension starts

If that matches your expectation I’ll escalate to leadership for an exceptions approval (credits + discount together require exec sign-off).

Thanks,
Nikhil
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com
(attachment: OrbitGrove-initial-scope.pdf)
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@orbitgrove.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:06:00 -0400
Subject: Re: OrbitGrove pilot kickoff — credit + extension proposal

Thanks, Nikhil.

Appreciate the offer — big picture: we expect 800k tokens/month during the pilot peak (mostly generation + similarity scoring), then likely 1.2–1.5M/month if we decide to go ahead. We do not have an approved PO yet; legal needs final SOW and pricing but we can sign once SOW + terms are agreed.

Two asks from our side to make the decision easier:
1) Lock the 30-day extension to start when we hit sandbox availability (gives us runway)
2) Bundle the 50k credit + 20% first-year discount into the same approval so internal stakeholders see total upside

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want.

—Ethan
Ethan Cole, Head of ML — OrbitGrove
(please see attached: OrbitGrove-requirements.docx)
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: OrbitGrove pilot kickoff — exec approval request (credits + discount)

Marissa / Hannah — forwarding the OrbitGrove ask. Short summary below and a suggested approval path.

Summary:
- Customer: OrbitGrove (Head of ML: Ethan Cole)
- Ask: 30-day trial extension (start-on-sandbox), 50k free-token credit, and 20% first-year discount tied to a 12-month commit
- Expected pilot peak: ~800k tokens/month, post-commit 1.2–1.5M/month
- Attachments: SOW draft + usage projections (attached)

Why approve? OrbitGrove is in a strategic vertical (supply-chain AI) and the integration is high visibility — successful pilot likely to convert to a committed account with strong usage. Bundling credit + discount reduces friction and accelerates PO.

Suggested terms (my recommended carve):
- 30-day extension (start when sandbox is available)
- 50k free-token credit applied pro rata to pilot consumption
- 20% discount off list for first 12 months after go-live, contingent on a 12-month minimum $commit (we propose $48k ARR minimum)

Open questions for leadership:
- Approve combined credits + discount as an exception? (This is cross-functional: finance & revenue ops need to sign off)
- If yes, any guardrails (cap credits, expiration, write-off treatment)?

Please advise and I can prepare a short one-pager for the exec review.

Best,
Nikhil
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: OrbitGrove pilot kickoff — exec approval request (credits + discount)

Nikhil — thanks for the clear summary. I’m comfortable greenlighting this with the following conditions:
1) Cap the credit exposure: apply the 50k free-token credit only during the pilot window and convert any unused credit to a one-time promotional credit (no refunds).
2) Make the 20% first-year discount contingent on a signed 12-month commitment at or above the $48k ARR you proposed. If they don’t hit the commit, discount clawback applies for months invoiced at list.
3) Legal to include an explicit start trigger (sandbox availability) and an automatic expiry for the extension if we do not receive a PO within 60 days of sandbox availability.

Hannah — could you confirm finance & RevOps are okay with accounting treatment and whether we should route through an incumbent promo code vs. custom billing item? If either of you wants to escalate to broader leadership I can loop in CFO/Head of Revenue.

Marissa
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@orbitgrove.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@orbitgrove.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: OrbitGrove pilot — approved promo package (summary & next steps)

Ethan / Priya — good news: leadership has approved the combined pilot package with standard guardrails. Summary below (approved):
- 30-day trial extension: will start when sandbox environment is provisioned. Sandbox must be provisioned within 60 days of approval or the extension offer expires.
- 50k free-token pilot credit: applied against pilot consumption only, capped to pilot window; unused credit converted to a one-time promotional credit (no cash value).
- 20% first-year discount: conditional on signing a 12-month minimum commitment at $48k ARR or greater. Discount clawback applies if commit not met.

Next steps:
1) I’ve attached the SOW draft and usage projection (OrbitGrove-SOW-draft.pdf, OrbitGrove-usage-projections.xlsx). Please review and confirm sandbox timing.
2) Legal will add the start-trigger language and the 60-day PO expiry clause.
3) RevOps will generate a promo code and the finance team will confirm accounting treatment (Hannah is cc’d).

Thanks — excited to get this moving. If you want a single doc summarizing the commercial terms for internal review I can produce one and route to DocuSign.

Cheers,
Nikhil
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
(attachments: OrbitGrove-SOW-draft.pdf; OrbitGrove-usage-projections.xlsx)
